title: Restore existing lint gate and repair six current errors
scope: Correct lint configuration and six actual source errors with semantics preserved, cap existing warnings at503 and wire lint into existing local and CI checks.
non_goals: No warning cleanup project, weakened global rules, new test/framework/CI job, scoring/identity/erasure semantic change, sanitizer removal, full W13/F10/F35/N18/customer/gate/release acceptance.
No npm ci dependency installation, full npm run ci/suite, deploy/migration/seed/bundle-build execution, network/cloud/credential/customer-data/commit/push/cleanup or subdelegation.

criteria.description: Actual npm run lint analyzes current .ts scope with zero errors and no more than503 warnings. Prefix corrected; existing warning rules unchanged. Existing local scripts.ci and GitHub typecheck job invoke lint before typecheck/tests; workflow wiring source-confirmed only.

Exactly six narrow lint-source repairs preserve lexical FakeD1 this, visitor-id accepted characters, SessionManager base semantics, erasure loop/body/exit behavior and byte-identical sanitizer expression. Existing two FakeD1 fixture suites pass; worker compiler/whitespace pass. No new tests or unrelated source edits.

Independent frozen actual-source/admission-patch/config/CI/pin/full worker-proof review and actual K1 once. Inspect K2/compiler/whitespace without rerun; keep aggregate-warning, operational deployment/provenance/recovery and full W13 limits explicit.
